notes: ACCESS: the assigned site_url /home-decor is not a real path on aerin.com; the live tree is /home/, /home/decor/, /home/tabletop-bar/, /home/furniture-mirrors/ and a separate top-level /lighting/. PerimeterX behind Fastly still 403s a plain requests/curl UA, WebFetch and the sitemap, and allorigins/codetabs/jina/corsproxy were all unusable this session (allorigins 500/520/522 on every target incl. example.com, r.jina.ai Cloudflare-challenged). A fresh curl_cffi profile sweep DID get through directly: chrome* profiles all 403, but safari17_0, safari17_2_ios, safari18_0, safari18_0_ios, edge99, edge101, firefox133 and chrome99_android all returned HTTP 200 with the genuine 283 KB page. All HTML below came from that direct route. robots.txt names no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web rule. TREE: parsed the full snowdogMenu mega-menu out of https://www.aerin.com/home/ (all 10 top-level departments, every level-1 and level-2 node). The ONLY furniture node on the whole site is Home > Furniture -> /home/furniture-mirrors/ (Magento category name "Furniture & Mirrors", body class categorypath-home-furniture-mirrors, h1 "Furniture & Mirrors"). Its only nav child is "All Furniture & Mirrors" pointing at the same URL, i.e. a §3 view-all, so this is a leaf, not a parent. No Outdoor/Patio, Bedroom, Office or Dining furniture department exists anywhere in the nav. COUNTS: the category page renders its grid and its #toolbar-amount header client-side from Klevu (0 occurrences of product-item and no toolbar-amount value in the served HTML), so the Klevu CATNAV totalResultsFound for the categoryPath IS the number the site reports. Klevu apiKey klevu-168114169562516258 (from #klevu_jsapikeys on the category page), endpoint https://uscs32v2.ksearchnet.com/cs/v2/search, request typeOfRequest=CATNAV, categoryPath="Home;Furniture & Mirrors" -> totalResultsFound 26. SANITY CHECKS: (a) exhaustion - offset 20 returned 6 records, offset 25 returned 1, offset 26 returned 0; a limit=100 pull returned exactly 26 records with 26 unique product ids. (b) discrimination - a bogus categoryPath "Home;Nonexistent Node" returned 0 and "Home;Decor;Picture Frames" returned 80, so the figure is not a constant site-wide total. (c) two reads seconds apart both gave 26. (d) the h1 of the page loaded is "Furniture & Mirrors", matching the slug. ABSENCE PROOF for the rest of the site: dumped the entire Klevu catalogue (1,616 records, 1,616 unique ids) and tallied every category token - the only furniture-shaped category value in the whole index is "Furniture & Mirrors" (26). A regex title scan for furnitur|sofa|chair|table|bed|desk|cabinet|wardrobe|stool|bench|dresser|shelv|bookcase|seating|nightstand|armchair|console|ottoman|settee|daybed|credenza|sideboard|vanity|banquette|chaise over all 1,616 names returned 140 hits, and every genuine furniture item among them is already inside Furniture & Mirrors; the remaining ~126 hits are table lamps / desk lamps / vanity lights (Lighting), desk trays and desk boxes (Office Accessories), vanity trays (Bathroom Accessories) and Tabletop & Bar items. No sofa, chair, bed, desk, cabinet, wardrobe, bench, bookcase or outdoor-furniture product exists on the site. COMPOSITION of the single leaf (all 26 titles read): 14 are furniture - Maxine Rattan Console, Maxine Rattan Coffee Table, Corvo Side Table, Shagreen Console x2, Shagreen Coffee Table, Shagreen Chess Side Table x2, Shagreen Telephone Side Table x2, Shagreen Game Table x2, Shagreen Vanity Table and Stool Set, Brass Butler Tray Stand; 3 are mirrors (Shagreen Wall Mirror, Shagreen Vanity Mirror, Shagreen Heart Hand Mirror - Wall Decor scope); 9 are decorative accessories (5 wastebaskets, 3 magazine racks, 1 umbrella stand). Furniture is the plurality and majority product type and the site itself labels the nav item "Furniture", so the node is kept, but there is no furniture-only child to split it on - flagged. EXCLUDED: all Lighting, Beauty, Fashion, Gifts, Registry, The Edit, Collaborations, Personalization, New Arrivals, Bestsellers, Heirloom Collection / Made to Order / Antique & Vintage / Curated & Collected (§3 collection and landing pages), and the whole Home > Decor and Home > Tabletop & Bar trees (frames, vases, candles, games, office and bathroom accessories, throws, dinnerware, flatware, barware, linens) - none is furniture.
